---
title: Compatibility and evidence
description: Source implementation, executed tests and local availability are three different questions.
---

This website describes revision `9ecf35fd9c3d6fbcbc1f8b72b8d4734c70037ffa`, reviewed on **27 September 2026**. It is a development snapshot, not a release candidate certification.

## Keep three kinds of information separate

**Implementation** means a source path exists. **Verification** means a named test or acceptance run exercised a specific revision and environment. **Availability** means your current session can reach an operation with the necessary configuration and consent. None of these automatically implies the other two.

## Observed development gates

The reviewed revision includes the merged Godot full-route fixes from PR #149. That PR completed with its required hosted checks green, including the real Godot integration and Driver Host conformance jobs, alongside the broader Rust, coverage, dependency, fuzz, packaging, platform and driver suites. A green PR gate is still repository evidence, not a universal application/version certification.

| Surface       | Evidence boundary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Figma         | A real Figma 126.5.6 public proof is pinned to its own reviewed revision `3cd86958…`. It exercised the authenticated first-party driver, official Plugin API, 14 persisted design roots, three prototype flows and artifact round-trip. It does not certify every Figma surface or WCAG conformance.                                    |
| Godot         | Parcel Lantern is now a public proof on this reviewed revision. The merged-SHA rerun crossed CLI → daemon → broker/policy → sandboxed first-party Godot driver → Host-mediated loopback → EditorPlugin → Godot 4.7.2, preserved the scene byte-for-byte, retained destructive consent boundaries and verified cleanup by clean restart. |
| Chromium      | Hosted real-browser integration exists on this development line; not every website, browser version or target race is certified.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| LibreOffice   | Documented real Writer, Calc and PDF operations through the driver path; not the entire UNO API.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Blender       | Driver source and hosted integration exist. A passing gate is not a claim of complete Blender, add-on or GUI-workflow coverage.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| KiCad and MLT | Source integrations and combined gates exist; semantic fixtures do not automatically establish every live editor round trip.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Linux desktop | Linux is the verified runtime host. Native backend evidence is narrower than a universal compositor or accessibility matrix.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| macOS         | The reviewed platform document describes native source foundations and separates hosted/native CI from live TCC desktop acceptance. Do not read a successful compile as live Mac certification.                                                                                                                                         |
| Windows       | Windows-related source is present in the repository, but the reviewed platform document does not establish a public live-support claim for this snapshot.                                                                                                                                                                               |

## Public proof and CI are different evidence

The [demo gallery](/demos/) contains bounded public proofs with their own pinned SHAs and receipts. CI answers whether a repository gate passed in its runner. A public proof additionally records the application, semantic route, intervention class, result and known non-claims.

The Figma proof is intentionally narrow: it proves the first-party driver route through the authenticated localhost bridge and official Plugin API, and does not claim that every operation in that acceptance run traversed the public CLI, daemon, broker and policy path. Parcel Lantern complements that boundary with a separate proof that keeps the CLI, daemon, broker, policy layer, sandbox, Host-mediated loopback and Godot EditorPlugin in the same observed route.

## Inspect your own environment

Use `semwright doctor` and capability discovery against the intended broker. A runtime status is a local observation, not independent security review or proof of production readiness. Packaging, installation validation and a live application matrix remain distinct work.

Evidence: [merged PR #149](https://github.com/seradotcom/semwright/pull/149), its green [Godot Driver Host conformance](https://github.com/seradotcom/semwright/actions/runs/36362681115/job/108742844993) and [real Godot integration](https://github.com/seradotcom/semwright/actions/runs/36362681115/job/108742845173), plus [the frozen source revision](https://github.com/seradotcom/semwright/tree/9ecf35fd9c3d6fbcbc1f8b72b8d4734c70037ffa). Reviewed 27 September 2026.

known_limitations: The Figma route is proven directly at Driver Protocol level; this acceptance does not claim every operation traversed the full CLI/daemon/broker/policy path.
A11y warnings remain and are explicitly triaged; this proof does not claim WCAG 2.2 AA certification.
Cloud/REST, FigJam, Slides, Buzz and Motion Beta are not all live-certified by this single acceptance run.

visual_preview.relationship: Rendered from scene bytes whose SHA-256 matches the merged-SHA proof workspace exactly. The preview is visual context, not the execution proof.

known_limitations: The final proof does not claim that movie.capture completed through the broker; that capability remained consent-gated during earlier media QA.
The auxiliary driver.godot.doctor diagnostic is not an acceptance criterion.
The proof covers the pinned Godot 4.7.2 workflow and scene; it is not a universal Godot/version certification.
